top_signals.title: Prabowo’s ‘Pragmatic’ Speech Calms Weary Indonesia Investors
top_signals.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto’s annual speech on Friday was a rare uneventful affair, and that’s exactly what investors wanted to hear. Stocks rallied, while bond yields fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Supply Crunch Grips Copper Market as Key Spread Flares Out
top_signals.summary: Copper was headed for another day of turbulent trading after a key indicator of short-term supply tightness on the London Metal Exchange spiked.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Russia summons Japanese envoy after Takaichi protests Putin’s visit to Etorofu
top_signals.summary: The island off the east coast of Hokkaido is one of four held by Russia that are known as the Northern Territories in Japan.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
